description:
## Goal

Replace the drain-time scan of every unresolved wait with exact, edge-triggered fact-producer pulls.

drive.rs::demand_blocked_wait_producers currently runs when the agenda drains, materializes the entire unresolved-wait inventory, deduplicates it through a HashSet, formats every FactKey with Debug to sort it, then asks the fact-to-producer map about each entry. This is a global pass over standing dependency state.

Fresh target-fixture signal:

- enum_take_drop_split: 873 of 2,708 work starts are attributed to BlockedWaiterExpansion;
- fz_f98_range_map_converges: 353 of 957;
- enum_predicate_search: 466 of 1,577.

Those counts do not prove the starts are unnecessary. The proven defect is that discovering the exact new wait edge still triggers a later full wait-table scan.

## Output contract

- When a completion introduces a new unsatisfied wait, the driver pulls that exact FactKey through World::demand_fact_producer.
- Chained waits expand one newly discovered frontier at a time.
- The FactKey -> producer map remains the only authority; no job pushes another job by name.
- Existing standing waits are not rescanned at agenda drain.
- Deterministic order follows the order waits were recorded; no Debug formatting or global sort is needed.
- A blocked job is not rerun until one of its waits is satisfied.

## TDD strategy

1. Pin a multi-hop blocked chain and record the exact producer-demand order.
2. Pin two coalesced waiters on one fact: the producer is demanded once.
3. Pin a permanently unresolved fact: the drive reports it without repeated scans or reruns.
4. Introduce exact wait-frontier expansion.
5. Delete demand_blocked_wait_producers and its HashSet/format-sort path.

## Telemetry acceptance

Consumes fz-kdt.34.

- full unresolved-wait scans are zero;
- every BlockedWaiterExpansion names the exact newly recorded FactUse that caused it;
- a blocked conclusion without a newly discovered wait causes no producer poke;
- work histograms and outputs are deterministic;
- root_scans and unsanctioned_work_starts remain zero.

Do not set a wall-clock or assume all current blocked-wait starts disappear; count only work the dependency graph proves unnecessary.
title: Replace drain-time unresolved-wait scans with edge-triggered fact pulls
